args.query: 重启 nanobot restart 服务
nanobot 服务管理 systemd supervisor 进程

args.command: ps aux | grep -i nanobot | grep -v grep
systemctl list-units --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -i nanobot; supervisorctl status 2>/dev/null | grep -i nanobot; pm2 list 2>/dev/null | grep -i nanobot
kill 506698 506550 && sleep 2 && cd /root/.nanobot && nohup nanobot gateway > /dev/null 2>&1 & echo "RESTARTED PID: $!"
